reuse.why: Extends the existing shared link guard that all six provider link functions call, and extracts unlinkAccount's field reset into clearBankLink so the takeover reuses it.

duplication.why: The unlink reset exists once (clearBankLink) and the takeover rule once (prepareBankAccountLink); providers only forward the flag.

placement.why: The rule lives in the single pre-link step in accounts/app.ts, after the closed-account check so refusals still change nothing; the flag sits on LinkAccountBaseParams.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Single clear point for the rule; the former assert now also mutates (renamed prepare...), and the holder is detached before the link itself is written, which a maintainer has to keep in mind.
